title: UPSC Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 13 Dental Surgeon, Ayurveda Physician and Other Posts
description: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies for 13 Dental Surgeons, Ayurveda Physicians, Scientist B, and other posts. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application.
